title: 第一千六百八十四章 捡到红玛瑙第一千六百八十三章 好心的女孩
slug: 荒村物语第一千六百九十四章面包
content_zh:
一人夜行。
独自穿越了一片荒凉的戈壁后，不知为何，这便出现在一片乱石丛中，无处可去，加上非常困顿，或许只好是坐了下来，赏看着这瑰奇的夜景。
石头是非常漂亮的。
那夜行人甚至打算扛一块石头回去，觉得这些都是宝贝，不是红玛瑙，便定然是祖母绿之类的物事。此时碰到，如何不怦然心动，如何不想着带一块这样的石头回去呢？
却终于还是抠不下来，那些长在石头上面的宝贝，纵使使出了九牛二虎之力，也休想拿下，万般无奈之下，夜行人只好是在怅叹了一声之后，便打算离去了。
况且他的腿还有些那个，不太方便，走起路来，非常难看，如此情形，再还要弄什么宝贝呢，保命要紧啊。
怀揣着这样的想法，夜行人这便不敢呆在这里了，却又舍不得这些奇宝。这样的存在，想必作为打工之人，打一辈子工都无法赚到吧？
于是下定决心扛了一块这样的石头在自己肩膀之上，可是不久之后，夜行人便感觉到非常之不堪，或许他的肩膀已然是被压断了吧？
只好是把那些稀世珍宝放了下来，而后怔怔地坐在一边看着，不知这特么到底该如何是好了嘛。想放弃，却又不舍，毕竟这样的宝贝，放在城里，那可是价值连城啊，此时碰到，如何能够善罢甘休呢？
可是他的肩膀断了。
身体也变得瘦弱不堪。
或许是过于用力，负荷太大，使得自己体力透支了，不然的话，怎么会变得如此消瘦，几乎连走路的力气也没得了呢？
饶是如此，夜行人仍旧还是不打算放弃这些宝贝。
那块镶嵌着红玛瑙的宝石已然是被他扛走了好远了，差不多有上百里路了都，这时饥饿，无法再继续，怕长此下去，或许真的不妥。
饿得眼睛都有些昏花了啊。
正不知如何是好之时，蓦然回首，看到此前出现在眼前的那些林立的乱石，到了这时，或许是可怜他吧，直接就变成了一片片连接在一起的森林。
这样的森林，为夜行人提供了一些方便，使得他可以住进去，栖身于那些苍老的古树上面的洞穴之中，而后悄悄地闭上了眼睛，姑且睡一觉，一切等天明了再说吧，不然呢？
“可是此前这里并非有森林啊。”夜行人蜷缩在那洞穴之中，望着外面的迷茫的夜雨，如此念叨着。
等雨不下了，这便出去一下，看看自己的宝贝，也就是此前那块红玛瑙了。还好，正摆放在洞穴门前，打算过了这一夜，等明天天亮了，再扛着这块红玛瑙，而后回到城里去。
那确实是一块非常大的红玛瑙。这样的宝贝，放眼世界，想必也没有能够与之匹敌的。

想到此处，夜行人非常高兴。
可是笑了一阵子，他便的打住，不笑了，觉得肚子实在是饿得慌，再不进食，恐怕不妥，正这时，看到森林里有无数的野兽出没。有些直接就出没于这洞穴边了，并且腿脚似乎变得不太方便，不然的话，想必走起路来，也不会变成这样啊。
夜行人抓住了一只这样的动物。
夜色迷朦，看不清楚到底是什么动物，不过这时也不管这么多了，能够使自己不饿死就成了。
content_en:
One person walks at night.
After crossing a desolate Gobi desert alone, for some reason, I ended up in a jumble of rocks. With nowhere to go, and being very trapped, I probably had no choice but to sit down and enjoy the marvelous night view.
The stones are very beautiful.
The night traveler even planned to carry a stone back, thinking that these were treasures. If they were not onyx, they must be emeralds or something like that. When I encounter it at this time, how can I not be moved by my heart? How can I not want to take a stone like this back with me?
But in the end, he still couldn't dig it out. Even if he tried his best to get those treasures growing on the stone, he couldn't get them. In desperation, the night traveler had no choice but to sigh and plan to leave.
Besides, his legs still have some problems, which are not very convenient, and it is very ugly when he walks. In such a situation, what kind of treasure should he get? It is important to save his life.
With this thought in mind, Night Traveler no longer dares to stay here, but he is reluctant to part with these rare treasures. With such an existence, as a working person, you must not be able to earn anything by working all your life, right?
So he made up his mind to carry such a stone on his shoulder, but soon after, Ye Xingren felt very unbearable. Maybe his shoulder had been crushed, right?
I had no choice but to put those rare treasures down, and then sit and watch them blankly, not knowing what to do. I want to give up, but I don't want to give up. After all, such a treasure is worth a lot of money in the city. How can I let it go when I encounter it now?
But his shoulder was broken.
The body also became very thin.
Perhaps he had exerted too much force and overloaded himself, which had exhausted his physical strength. Otherwise, how could he have become so thin that he could hardly even walk?
Even so, Night Walker still has no intention of giving up these treasures.
The gem inlaid with onyx had already been carried a long way by him, almost hundreds of miles. At this time, he was hungry and could not continue. He was afraid that if it continued like this, it might really be wrong.
I'm so hungry that my eyes are a little dizzy.
Just when he didn't know what to do, he suddenly looked back and saw the rows of rocks that had appeared in front of him before. At this time, maybe he felt pity for him, because they had turned into a forest connected together.
Such a forest provides some convenience for night travelers, allowing him to live in and roost in the caves above the old trees, then quietly close his eyes and take a nap. Let's wait until daybreak to talk about everything, otherwise?
"But there wasn't a forest here before." Ye Xingren huddled in the cave, looking at the confused night rain outside, and muttered.
When the rain stops, I will go out and take a look at my treasure, which is the red agate from before. Fortunately, it was placed in front of the cave door. I planned to spend the night and wait until dawn tomorrow to carry this piece of red agate back to the city.
It was indeed a very large onyx. Such a treasure, if you look around the world, there must be no one that can compete with it.
Thinking of this, the night traveler was very happy.
But after laughing for a while, he stopped laughing. He felt that he was really hungry and it would be inappropriate not to eat anymore. At this moment, he saw countless wild beasts coming and going in the forest. Some of them appeared directly next to the cave, and their legs and feet seemed to have become inconvenient. Otherwise, walking would not be like this.
The night traveler caught one such animal.
The night was dim and I couldn't see clearly what kind of animal it was, but I didn't care about that much at this time, as long as I could prevent myself from starving to death.
